title: kbgit.py is a CLI over kg_* modules
goal: Where the co-change verdict supports it, kbgit.py's merge and ledger repair, trailers and hooks, history, and sync live in kg_merge.py, kg_trailers.py, kg_history.py and kg_sync.py; kbgit.py keeps every command, argument, output and exit code; no kg_ module imports kbgit.py; the suite, the stress suite and the import test pass

gates.question: Which kbgit.py sections move out, given the co-change report?
options: the four sections the report supports
only the sections the report marks independent
gates.recommendation: only the sections the report marks independent
gates.answer: only the sections the report marks independent

notes: The file already has section rules: io, text, _sources.csv, renumbering, answer ids, _fetch_state.csv, Markdown ledgers, baseline (merge and fix); trailers and hooks; history (log, blame, asof, census tag); sync. Tests that patch kbgit attributes must patch the kg_ module that now owns the name. A task whose section the report says to keep is dropped with the report's reason.
